entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Author: D.Ramesh
Bench: D.Ramesh
 The Honourable Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No.3324 of 2020
O R D E R:

This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner/A1 under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeking to quash entire proceedings in Crime No.273 of 2020 on the file of Kavali Rural Police Station, Kavali, Nellore District.
The offences alleged are under Sections 272, 273, 328 of IPC and Section 59(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
2. Heard the counsel for the petitioner/A-1 and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner so also the learned Additional Public Prosecutor would submit that the issue involved in the present case is squarely covered by the common order, dated 27.08.2018, of this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch wherein Criminal Petition No.6754 of 2018 was allowed.

4. Since the issue involved in the present case is identical to the order passed in Criminal Petition No.6754 of 2018 vide common order, dated 27.08.2018, of this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch, following the said order and in terms thereof, this Criminal Petition is allowed and all the proceedings against the petitioner/A1 in Crime No.273 of 2020 on the file of Kavali Rural Police Station, Kavali, Nellore District are hereby quashed.
5. Registry shall enclose a copy of the common order, dated 27.08.2018, of this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch to this order.
